# proxmox_sdn_dns (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN DNS provider from `/cluster/sdn/dns`. The provider key is not exposed, only its fingerprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_dns" "app" {
  dns = proxmox_sdn_dns.app.dns
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns` (String) DNS provider to read.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (String) DNS provider identifier.
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `reverse_mask_v6` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
